record.paper_title: Some of my favorite open problems
record.context_brief: sharp relative isoperimetric inequality for the cube
record.original_question: Let Q be the unit cube in R^N with N >= 2. For a measurable subset S of Q, let |S| be its volume and P(S) its relative perimeter inside Q, and define f_N(t)=inf{P(S): S subset Q is measurable and |S|=t}. In dimension N=2, an explicit formula for f_2(t) is known. For N >= 3, is there an analogous formula for f_N(t)? In particular, is f_N(t) identically 1 near t=1/2?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 10.1 ([21]). Is there a formula similar to (10.2) for f_N(t) when N >= 3? In particular, is it true that f_N(t) is identically 1 near t = 1/2?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $N\ge 2$ and let $Q=[0,1]^N$ denote the unit cube in $\mathbb{R}^N$. For a measurable set $S\subset Q$, let $|S|$ denote its Lebesgue measure and let $P(S)$ denote its relative perimeter in $Q$, i.e. the $(N-1)$-dimensional Hausdorff measure of $\partial^* S \cap \operatorname{int}(Q)$ (where $\partial^* S$ is the reduced boundary of $S$). Define the relative isoperimetric profile of the cube by
$$f_N(t) \;=\; \inf\{\,P(S) : S\subset Q\text{ measurable},\ |S|=t\,\},\qquad t\in[0,1].$$
In dimension $N=2$ an explicit closed-form expression for $f_2(t)$ is known: for $t\in[0,1/2]$,
$$f_2(t)=\begin{cases} 2\sqrt{t/\pi}\cdot(\pi/2) & \text{if } 0\le t\le \pi/16,\\[2pt] \text{(corresponding circular-arc / straight-line formula)} & \text{otherwise,}\end{cases}$$
with $f_2(t)=f_2(1-t)$, and in particular $f_2(t)\equiv 1$ for $t$ in a neighborhood of $1/2$ (the minimizer being a half-cube cut by a straight segment).

Question. For every $N\ge 3$, determine an analogous explicit formula for $f_N(t)$ on $[0,1]$. In particular, decide whether there exists $\delta_N>0$ such that
$$f_N(t)\;=\;1\qquad \text{for all } t\in[\,1/2-\delta_N,\;1/2+\delta_N\,],$$
i.e.\ whether the relative isoperimetric profile of the $N$-cube is identically $1$ in a neighborhood of $t=1/2$.
artifact.status_search_result: The explicit form of the relative isoperimetric profile of the unit cube in dimension $N\ge 3$ does not appear in the literature; recent work (e.g. Chambers–Mouillé, 2023) treats only restricted classes (orthogonal polyhedra in $[0,1]^3$) and does not resolve the general profile or the flatness near $t=1/2$. No source found establishing the closed-form formula for $f_N(t)$ or proving $f_N\equiv 1$ near $1/2$ for $N\ge 3$, so the problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: On the relative isoperimetric problem in [0,1]^3 for orthogonal polyhedra
status_evidence.snippet: The minimizers are of the form [0,ε]^3, [0,ε]^2 × [0,1], or [0,ε] × [0,1]^2 for some ε > 0.
status_evidence.claim: Recent progress on the relative isoperimetric problem for the 3-cube is restricted to orthogonal polyhedra and does not give the general profile.
